description: This file contains test cases for the 'Terms' schema in a Perl project, utilizing Test2::V0 for testing database interactions and schema methods related to date validity, neighbors, and state checks.

classes.name: Terms
classes.description: A schema class representing terms with validity periods and related methods for date-based validation, neighbor retrieval, and state checks.

methods.name: valid_on_date
methods.description: Returns the term valid on a specific date.

methods.name: valid_today_rs
methods.description: Returns a result set of terms valid today.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Populates the database with a list of terms.

methods.name: neighbors
methods.description: Retrieves neighboring terms relative to the current one.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Retrieves the next term(s) after the current one.

methods.name: previous
methods.description: Retrieves the previous term(s) before the current one.

methods.name: cmp_validity_today
methods.description: Compares the term's validity with today.

methods.name: reasons_to_freeze
methods.description: Determines if the term can be frozen (not in future).

methods.name: reasons_to_keep
methods.description: Determines if the term can be kept (not in future or currently valid).
